title: feat(cli): `os migrate meta --write` — the AST codemod that rewrites authored sources for the mechanical `applied` set (v18)
body:
Commissioned by maintainer ruling on #9529 (2026-08-18, live PM chat with the triage seat, session `session_01EUZUjvnLsqwHVkXkTv8TKQ`; verbatim: 「其他接受你的建议」— Option 2 now, Option 1 as a v18 Feature). This card is Option 1.

## Scope

Implement the in-place rewrite that the retirement prescriptions promise: an AST codemod (`ts-morph` is already a `packages/cli` dependency) over `objectstack.config.ts` and per-artifact authored modules (`defineView` / `defineAgent` / `defineFlow` shapes), covering **the mechanical `applied` set only** — the chain's semantic TODOs stay manual, exactly as #9529 records. Suggested flag shape: `--write` (in-place) alongside the existing `--out` snapshot; dry-run remains the default.

When this lands, the shared retirement sentence in `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts` (reworded to the honest replay-and-print statement by #9529's Option-2 half) may be restored to the automatic-rewrite claim it then honestly makes — that restoration belongs to this card's PR, in lockstep with the class-wide pin.

## Scheduling

Deliberately **not** current-cycle work.

`Restart-when: the v18 major development cycle opens (first v18 changeset-major accepted on main), or a maintainer instruction pulls it forward`

## Refs

#9529 (the promise-vs-tool gap and its measurement) · #9418 (the load-refusal half this builds on) · #6856 (the 2026-08-09 sentence ruling).
